title: Create session request
description: Body of POST /sessions. Authentication is still fake: a name is enough. Without encounter the Scribe arrives in the world, on map (or the starting map); with encounter the session is a single fight.

encounter.description: Optional. A fight-only session against this encounter.

map.description: Optional. The map where the Scribe arrives, on its start Anchor. Defaults to the starting map.

sets.description: Optional. The gear sets the Scribe prepares; the first one is active. Defaults to the starting loadout.

seed.description: Optional. The same seed and the same actions always give the same fight.
